name: Regex

sections.heading: Ownership and complexity
sections.text: Exact typed owner contract; no copy/borrow/clone capability inferred from spelling Actual owned typed Regex.compile(pattern) with the current default options, Regex.escape(Text), and isMatch(Text), reusing native pattern_find rather than a Python runtime or fixed report. Initial public native profile is Unicode literal patterns and escaped punctuation only: 256 pattern bytes, 4096 text bytes, 65536 search steps. Regex metacharacter operators/captures and custom options are explicitly rejected in this source profile; the wider SDK model is not counted as native source coverage. Independent Python re search/escape oracles, two live values and explicit return variations are executed. Literal matching and escaped punctuation; 256 pattern bytes; 4096 input bytes; bounded steps; no full regex claim
